ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reducedRibbonNo.docstring:
The canonical identification, with the actual quotient projection as
its underlying map, of reduced ribbon loops and the normalizer quotient.
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reducedRibbonNo.elaborated_type:
{I : Type u_1} →
  (M : CoxeterMatrix.{u_1} I) →
    [inst : Finite.{u_1 + 1} (CoxeterMatrix.Group.{u_1} M)] →
      (X : ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonObject.{u_1} M) →
        MulEquiv.{u_1, u_1} (↥(ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reducedRibbonLoops.{u_1} M X))
          (ArtinNormalisers.Artin.normalizerQuotient.{u_1} M
            (ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonObject.indices.{u_1} X))

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.landmark_2_grou.docstring:
The same chosen relations present the actual signed groupoid: every
assignment to any groupoid satisfying only these primitive relations has
exactly one genuine functor extension.
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.landmark_2_grou.elaborated_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix.{u_1} I) [inst : Finite.{u_1 + 1} (CoxeterMatrix.Group.{u_1} M)]
  {C : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Groupoid.{u_3, u_2} C]
  (D : ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGeneratorData.{u_2, u_3, u_1} M C),
  ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGeneratorData.RespectsLcm.{u_2, u_3, u_1} D →
    ExistsUnique.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)}
      fun
        (F :
          CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, u_3, u_1, u_2}
            (↑(ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid.{u_1} M)) C) =>
      (Eq.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)} (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_3, u_1, u_2} F)
          fun (X : ↑(ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid.{u_1} M)) =>
          ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGeneratorData.obj.{u_2, u_3, u_1} D ↑X) ∧
        ∀ (X : ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonObject.{u_1} M) (a : I)
          (ha : a ∉ ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonObject.indices.{u_1} X),
          HEq.{u_3 + 1}
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.map.{u_1, u_3, u_1, u_2} F
              (ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.actualAtomicHom.{u_1} M X a ha))
            (ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGeneratorData.atom.{u_2, u_3, u_1} D X a ha)
